# Omena

> Omena is a semantic CSS tooling platform for evidence-aware diagnostics, transformations, CSS Modules, Sass, editor workflows, and build automation.

Omena documentation is published as prerendered HTML. The repository is available at https://github.com/omenien/omena-css.

## Start

- [Documentation home](https://omena.dev/)
- [Getting started](https://omena.dev/docs/getting-started/)
- [Browser playground](https://omena.dev/docs/playground/)
- [VS Code extension](https://omena.dev/docs/vscode-extension/)
